images.description: Kill and relaunch three times on Language after closing the sign-up trial paywall. BEFORE (main 5ba33c951c): the trial paywall comes back on every relaunch. AFTER (this PR): every relaunch resumes on Language with no paywall; the app's preferences hold the stored answer (closed) and arm (control). Real simulator shots, iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.2, local backend.

Arm stickiness. A new account's first arm read falls back to control (local_dev has no PostHog); a build whose every read answers pocket (debug arm override) is then installed over it, app data kept. BEFORE (main): each of three relaunches shows the sign-up paywall again, then the 30-day downsell, then switches to pocket. AFTER (this PR): all three relaunches stay on control's Language step. Real simulator shots.

AFTER, a new account on the pocket build: the sign-up paywall (closed) and the 30-day downsell (declined) are each offered once; three relaunches reopen pocket's Permissions step with no second paywall or downsell. Real simulator shots.
